notes.title: 1.0.13 New Map - Mountain Hall
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/afec683c077f9006a177f351f4f3c07607c4a069.png[/img]

Hail to you Champions,

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Map - Mountain Hall! [/b]
Welcome to the Mountain Hall, where the Petram are made from molten stone. This is a map with twice the enemy spawns so either gear up or grab a friend to beat this level in multiplayer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/203a155ca403d4d9d90ea7789ed6425a7f30cf62.png[/img]
[i]The Mountain Hall - Double tracks in action[/i]

[*] [b]First map released with TWO enemy spawns[/b]
More maps will come with up to 4x the enemy streams for more multiplayer fun (or a real single player challenge) What environments would you like to see?
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] HUGE performance boost for calculating a lot of enemies/projectiles on screen, should run smoother now!
[/list]

We're hard at work on two big updates to how Cliff & Field works:
[olist]
[*] We want to make a mode where you build your own path by placing down walls & towers (more like the classic WC3 TDs)
[*] We want to turn it more into a roguelike TD where every run is unique and has a combination of skill and luck to it
[/olist]

More on these two updates soon!

Happy stone hunting!
Max & Gideon

notes.title: 1.0.12 - Challenges, UI & improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/900c8a8a9ee382ebdb4afab500cb0b6a2a414052.png[/img]
Hail to you Champion!

This version introduces a new concept that'll give you more content and an opportunity to get more gems! We've also been hard at work doing some bottom up optimizations of the game and are happy to tell you it's now running smoother than ever. We're not done yet but it's shaping up every week!

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
Every day, week and month new challenges appear! You're limited to only 5 different towers and can see any level or mode show up. We'll keep developing the challenges to add even more aspects of difficulty to it over time. If you complete challenges you'll be able to get both achievements and more gems.

You'll find challenges right in the main menu and they'll be refreshed automagically!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/39a3b6dfe2960177e0b871f98781912ca604605d.png[/img]
The new challenges menu!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenges! Read more about them above
[*] Better formatting of numbers throughout the game! What used to be 123456 will now be 123,456 or even 123k depending on where you'll find it.
[*] New main menu UI
[*] Profile is now available from the main menu
[*] Added a subtitle to the main menu showing when the next update is coming
[*] Achievements now store the date they were completed on
[*] Added 22 new achievements related to challenges!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/53c754dc00479dbfe5b91015ded7354d64d6e289.png[/img]
The new menu UI!

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] VASTLY improved how collisions are calculated, should make the game much more performant!
[*] Made the immune-hit sound less prominent
[*] Added an extra check if you've completed achievements on starting the game
[*] Changed all the click sounds to new ones!
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where user and player names including special characters or spaces would crash the game
[*] Fixed a bug where sound was missing from some of the settings
[/list]


As always - [b]thank you[/b] for playing Cliff & Field! We hope you like this update and will continue to support us as we make this game better!

Best,
Gideon & Max

notes.title: 1.0.9 Enemies + Bug-fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/71c9c0f5dd0c6352da5ec212d074b6d09d962564.png[/img]

Hello all Champions,

1.0.9 is out with game balancing, better UI, updated enemies and a lot of stability fixes.
Thank you all for playing! It is so fun for us to see the leaderboards and all the feedback you guys bring up!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Obsidian enemies that are immune to lots of things!
[*] You can now use the middle mouse button to PING on the map!
[*] New +10 gold drops from enemies
[*] New player UI in top left corner
[*] New sound on calling a wave (sweet little battle drums)
[*] Archers no longer cause bleed but have a 5% Critical Hit Chance to deal 2x the damage
[*] Snipers also have a 5% Critical Hit Chance
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Your level progress now saves between rounds! And all the progress you had before should be put back in (Sorry about that)
[*] Reduced the number of fatal crash calls so should crash less!
[*] Better stability overall in multiplayer!
[*] Sniper upgrades have been renamed
[*] Immune sound effects are back in multiplayer
[*] Arrows on the path now disappear as they should when loading a save
[*] You can now continue on victory
[*] Info panel for towers now have white text again
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Drop rate increased to 1% flat
[*] You now earn more money for late game enemies
[*] Some enemies have had their health adjusted to make progression more even
[*] Obelisk tower speed boost reduced to +25% (down from +50%)
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes a multiplayer game will not sync correctly and won't start for one of the players. If that happens just try again! 60& of the time it works, every time!
[*] The auto loot upgrade on the obelisk doesn't work, fixing in an upcoming version
[*] Sometimes Mac computers will crash the game if you have denied internet access and it tries to upload your leaderboard score
[/list]

Good luck defending your kingdom!
Max & Gideon

notes.title: Multiplayer & Updated Enemies - 1.0.8 is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/6a3ddb38a90ba15dc4c0f88b55364e93b588dd9c.png[/img]

Hello all Champions, happy 2023! 
To celebrate the new year we're releasing a very early preview of multiplayer with Cliff & Field! There's [u][b]LOTS[/b][/u] more to do here but we wanted you to get access to try it out while we iron out the last few kinks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/fbcc9e44a944ab55c8cedb812fd8356ff006d2e5.png[/img]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] MULTIPLAYER! You can now host a lobby and play with your friends (up to 4 people) - note that this is in an early alpha so you might encounter some bugs & issues. Please let us know in our Discord and we'll do our best to fix it!
[*] Enemies are updated with new visuals & balancing - there's another big update coming for enemies and bosses but this is a big step from what they used to look like!
[*] Rewrote spawning for all enemies and projectiles to be more efficient and faster
[*] Temporarily removed the XP boost drop while we build it for multiplayer
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/516f6e82655c51cc68420b6c77d58eaf15607f12.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where save files would miss some tower upgrades, should save properly now!
[*] Fixed a bug where save games would not delete properly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Archer upgrade "Arcane Arrows" to have 1 dmg (now 4 dmg)
[*] Removed randomness in placement of enemies spawning other enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where wave tips would always turn back on
[*] Upgraded the Sentry version
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you have a save from a previous version that you try to load the game MIGHT crash and will delete that save - new saves are not affected!
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing our game and we hope you like it!

Best, 
Max & Gideon

notes.title: Cursed 1.0.6 arrives! Win + Mac
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/beeb8169aa6d1b57c338a3b7d7770636060e5b33.png[/img]

Champions! A new cursed patch is out with a lot of fixes and updates. Enjoy!

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
The game sometimes crashes randomly (working on getting this fixed, every crash helps us gather more information, sorry for any inconvenience)

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]CURSES[/b] are here! You'll get cursed on wave 60 and then every 7 waves after that - but the Dark Wizard isn't too evil. You can choose one of three random curses to make every playthrough new and exciting. How far can you make it?
[*] The first version of the Bestiary is here! You can now see all tower upgrade lines (although it still needs a lot of polish) if you click the little question mark on a building. More coming soon!
[*] Steam Leaderboard for all-time highest wave (with and without revives) and total kills!
[*] Certain waves will now give you a tip if you're defeated on that particular wave to help you get further next time
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made wave 70 spawn enemies much faster!
[*] Respeccing skills now cost 100 gems during early access (down from 500)
[*] Increased loot drop rate by +100%!
[*] Increased size of loot by +33%!
[*] Bosses can now NOT be stunned anymore!
[*] Wave 99 is now much harder - was way too easy before!
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Obelisk didn't help target Cloaked enemies with its upgrade
[*] Fixed a bug where the loading screen wouldn't fade to black when starting a game
[*] Fixed a bug where the next level upgrade and gem cost was visible on the in-game skill tooltips
[*] Fixed so that erratic projectiles are now pointing in the direction they're flying
[*] Fixed the wave number that was displaying one wave too high in the last patch
[*] Made it so that the little spawn early button now hides if you complete a wave and don't have autoplay next wave on - less confusing!
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4 out! Call next wave early + fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/6a95193445c96cacfefd4a4bfa2a6d587cb177a9.png[/img]
Thank you, Champions, for helping to make Cliff & Field even better with your feedback!
Here's the latest update to the game:

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New temporary look for enemies that are cloaked (now posing as a bush!), fortified (now with a silly helmet) and healing (now with healing particles)! Will be refined in an upcoming version
[*] You can now call the next wave early! As soon as 50% of the current wave enemies have spawned you can press E or a very small button at the start of the road to call the next wave!
[*] Skill hotkeys! You can now use numbers 1-9 to use the skill in that slot! Soon also to speed build towers (next release, known issue is that you can't use hotkeys with the build menu open)
[*] New achievements for building towers!
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes & changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the auto-loot-upgrade on the Obelisk wouldn't pick up the loot
[*] Added some short descriptions to help the upgrade tooltips be more readable
[*] Reduced the loot frequency and stabilized the loot so it's equal over each wave
[*] Fixed a translation error in the intro scene

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Performance, new features and bugfixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/00555f517d123c569ce655ead6d476cc384d3152.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that locked you in Freeplay forever!
[*] Fixed an error on the Lightning Tower L2T5 upgrade where the range was reduced

[*] Fixed the placement of the Obelisk that was a little bit off!
[*] Fixed a bug that displayed removed AOE damage as 0,0
[/list]

notes.title: Cliff & Field releasing in Early Access this Friday Nov 4th!
notes.content:

[h2]Hi all Champions,[/h2]

[b]It's finally time to release Cliff & Field to Early Access![/b]
Thank you for all the amazing feedback, bug hunting, and tips we've gotten over the past few months.

At 8 pm CET we're releasing Cliff & Field so that we can finish the game together with you all!
We'll keep adding levels, towers, skills, features and loads of other things to the game in the coming months and would love to hear your feedback and ideas as we do it!

Best,
Gideon & Max

notes.title: New modes - Demo 0.9.6 released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41725533/3585629ba312ba3b95c2940645dbc364da9fe125.png[/img]

Beloved Champions,

It's here! A big update to the demo before we soon release this game in Early Access!

[*] Improved mouse click and drag
[*] Improved the visibility of damage numbers and affix callouts in the world
[*] Updated some of the wave descriptions
[*] Fixed a typo in the Cannon tower description
[*] Changed cannon start AOE-radius from 4 -> 3
[*] Changed cannon start AOE-dmg from 2 -> 1
[*] Changed cannon "Cannonbombs" upgrade AOE-radius from 2 -> 4
[*] Changed cannon "Cannonbombs" upgrade AOE-damage from no change -> 2
[/list]

notes.title: New demo update - now WAY better performance!
notes.content:
Hello champions,

We’re super excited to release this new update where we worked a lot on improving the performance while playing the game.

We received feedback from a lot of you that it needed to run smoother and faster so we set out to accomplish exactly that. This is our first update of many to address performance.

[b]Here’s what’s included in this update 0.9.5:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved accessibility why am picking up loot including particle effects
[*] Improved terrain performance 
[*] Occlusion culling (to improve rendering performance, silly of us to have disabled that)
[*] Mesh grouping (also for improved performance)
[/list]

We hope this update allows more people to play the game and please let us know in the steam community if you encounter any errors and will try to fix the best we can in the next coming days!

Thanks for playing!
Gideon
